title: Old tunes: Corrine, Go Along Mule, Italy
summary: Barnes lists tunes of the period, saying Corrine was made for someone by Bunk Johnson.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: You said the Go Along Mural, what was some of the other two? Corrine was at that period you said?
Corrine was in it too. But you see Corrine was a song that Bump just actually made that for Lloyd.

Yeah, Bump Johnson. He used to keep Lloyd for that. You see Corrine, Corrine, oh, since you've been gone. You see, that was old time. Then you go along and work and Italy. That was another one too. Italy? Italy.
Yeah, I don't remember that. I heard about that.
